appraisal_events.evidence: "une bien sainte femme... une bonne femme, vous pouvez dire, qui ne plaignait pas les perdreaux, ni les faisans"; "s'il y a une femme qui peut compter d'aller près du bon Dieu, sûr et certain que c'est elle."
appraisal_events.explanation: Françoise's extended reminiscence praises Mme Octave (tante Léonie) as saintly, generous, and devoted to feeding her guests and servants well, without narratorial irony undercutting the content.

appraisal_events.evidence: "Elle a la plus grande situation dans le faubourg Saint-Germain, elle a la première maison du faubourg Saint-Germain"; her guests are figured as "les colonnes qui soutenaient le temple" and "les statues d'or des apôtres de la Sainte-Chapelle" — set against the narrator watching her fuss over her veil and sleeves "comme une reine qui a accepté de représenter... ce rôle, si inférieur à elle."
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator sustains, at length and with sacred/temple imagery, the conviction that the duchesse presides over an unmatched, almost consecrated social eminence, even though his direct observation of her ordinary, fashion-conscious person is comparatively deflating.

status_effects.explanation: Françoise's eulogistic account clearly elevates tante Léonie's memory as generous and saintly.
She is affirmed, via a family friend's testimony and sustained sacred imagery, as holding the foremost social position in the faubourg Saint-Germain.
Observed directly, she appears as an ordinary, vain, fashion-conscious woman playing a role the narrator calls 'inferior to her,' deflating the mythic aura of her name.

ambiguities: The passage layers a narrator-endorsed social elevation of Mme de Guermantes (via her milieu's reputation and sacred imagery) against a directly witnessed personal diminishment (her ordinary vanity about dress); the narrator himself is uncertain whether this gap reflects her true nature or 'l'impuissance de mon esprit,' so the elevation and diminishment are recorded together rather than resolved into a single verdict.
